verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no credential vault, no TOTP/2FA handling, and no mechanism for keeping secrets hidden from the model. Browser profiles let a user log in once manually and reuse the session, which is a separate session-persistence capability. Custom tools are only a developer building block that could be used to build such a flow, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can store credentials in a vault and have the agent complete logins including TOTP/2FA challenges without exposing secrets to the model
